races.name: Rootkin
races.description: Tree-aliens. Bio and kinetic weapons: seeds, thorns, strangling vines. Every tower is rooted — it starts at 85% strength and gains damage and range for each wave it stands through (for up to six waves), so a Rootkin line that holds early becomes the strongest in the game. Strong against the Assembly's plating, weak against their own kind.
races.tagline: Grows into the game: weak saplings, unstoppable elders.

passive.name: Rooted
passive.description: Towers start at 85% damage and gain +5% damage and +2.5% range per wave they stand through, up to 6 waves.

races.name: The Assembly
races.description: A machine collective. Kinetic ordnance: nailguns, pile drivers, mortars, a railgun. Guns spin up — every shot within a second of the last makes the next one faster, up to 30% — and kills pay 10% more scrap. The price: upgrades cost 20% more. Strong against Lumenari shields, weak against plating of their own make.
races.tagline: Burst and salvage: guns spin up, scrap pays, upgrades cost.

passive.name: Spin-up
passive.description: Each shot within 1 s of the last fires the next 6% sooner, up to 30%. Kills pay +10%. Upgrades cost +20%.

races.name: Chitin Swarm
races.description: Insectoid hive. Bio weapons: acid, darts, webs. Towers are cheap and the hive links them — each other tower within 1.5 tiles makes a tower fire 10% faster (up to three) — and acid stacks three deep instead of refreshing. The price: a sold tower refunds only half. Strong against plating, weak against organic foes.
races.tagline: Numbers and acid: cheap towers that are stronger together.

passive.name: Hive link
passive.description: Each other tower within 1.5 tiles: +10% fire rate (max 3). Acid damage over time stacks up to 3×. Selling refunds 50%.

races.name: Lumenari
races.description: Energy beings. Beams, pulses and time fields. Beams pierce through up to two creeps behind the target, and any tower that has waited 2 s opens with an overcharged shot at 2.5× damage. The price: everything fires 8% slower. Strong against organic foes, weak against shields of their own kind.
races.tagline: Few and precise: pierce the line, open with an alpha strike.

passive.name: Overcharge
passive.description: After 2 s idle the next shot deals 2.5×. Beams pierce 2 extra creeps along the line at 50%. Towers fire 8% slower.
